properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued July 31 at 5:44PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
At 544 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm near
Erie, or 24 miles north of Denver, moving southeast at 15 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph and half inch size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor damage to outdoor objects is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Northeastern Thornton, northeastern Broomfield, Erie, Firestone,
Frederick, Dacono, Todd Creek and Wattenburg.

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued July 31 at 5:25PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
At 525 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 9
miles northeast of Trinchera, or 28 miles north of Des Moines, moving
east at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Heavy rain, wind gusts up to 50 mph and half inch hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Branson and Trinchera.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued July 31 at 4:52PM MDT until July 31 at 7:45PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
FFWPUB

The National Weather Service in Pueblo has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The North and Middle Aspen Acres Burn Scar in...
East Central Custer County in southeastern Colorado...
West Central Pueblo County in southeastern Colorado...

* Until 745 PM MDT.

* At 452 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain moving into the North and Middle Aspen Acres Burn Scar.
Up to 0.2 inches of rain have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is
1 to 2 inches in 1 hour. Additional rainfall amounts up to 1 inch
are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or
expected to begin shortly. Excessive rainfall over the burn scar
will result in debris flow. The debris flow can consist of rock,
mud, vegetation and other loose materials.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding in and around the North and Middle Aspen
Acres Burn Scar.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
North and Middle Aspen Acres Burn Scar.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Beulah and San Isabel.

This includes the following high risk locations...
Beulah Water Intake, Northcreek Road county line to Red Mountain Camp
and Northcreek Road from Red Mountain Camp to Beulah.
